title: Case V (Serial 0565.00–0565.03): Pilot and Copilot Drawings of Object Seen from DC-3, 1948
description: Two shaded illustrations of the same elongated, wingless object trailing exhaust, labeled "Pilot" and "Copilot". The pilot's version has a segmented hull and a callout "Cockpit windshield?"; the copilot's version shows two rows of rectangular windows with callouts "Windows with white light" and "Black". The text describes a DC-3 crew's sighting at 0340 hours on July 24, 1948 of a rocket- or jet-powered object with a trail of fire about 50 feet long (page 81).
